bibl.title: Prayers and Petitions for Justice. Despair and the "Crossing of Boundaries" between Religion and Law.
bibl.seg: Chrysi Kotsifou, Prayers and Petitions for Justice. Despair and the "Crossing of Boundaries" between Religion and Law.
bibl.note: What is a prayer? What is a petition? - The sources: Prayers for justice on papyrus [in Demotic, Greek and Coptic]; - Petitions. - Overlaps in terminology and persuasion strategies: Terminology; - Persuasion strategies and emotions. - Social and cultural milieu of prayers for justice on papyrus. - "Law in practice" borrowing from the language of prayers for justice. - Conclusion.
